output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
    theme: cosmo
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Clean up whitespace to prevent URL breaks
dt$viz_owner_repo <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo)
dt$title <- trimws(dt$title)

cat('<h2>Interactive Visualization Gallery</h2>')
cat('<hr>')
cat('<table class="table" style="width:100%;">')
cat('<thead><tr><th style="width:300px;">Screenshot</th><th>Project Details</th></tr></thead>')
cat('<tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  # Extract repo name (removes the 'aakritixyz/' prefix)
  repo <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  
  # Construct the absolute URL to the image in the ROOT of the repo
  # We add a timestamp (?t=) to force GitHub to bypass old 404 caches
  timestamp <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  img_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo, "/Capture.PNG?t=", timestamp)
  demo_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo, "/")
  
  cat('<tr>')
  
  # Image Cell: Using a fallback to 'capture.png' (lowercase) just in case
  cat('<td>')
  cat(paste0('<a href="', demo_url, '">'))
  cat(paste0('<img src="', img_url, '" '))
  cat(paste0('onerror="this.onerror=null; this.src=\'[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)', repo, '/capture.png\';" '))
  cat('width="280" style="border:2px solid #ddd; border-radius:4px; padding:5px;">')
  cat('</a>')
  cat('</td>')
  
  # Details Cell
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle;">')
  cat(paste0('<h3>', dt$title[i], '</h3>'))
  cat(paste0('<p><a class="btn btn-primary" href="', demo_url, '" target="_blank">View Interactive Demo</a></p>'))
  cat(paste0('<p><a href="', dt$source[i], '" target="_blank">View Source Code on GitHub</a></p>'))
  cat('</td>')
  
  cat('</tr>')
}

cat('</tbody></table>')
